about.title: Los Angeles Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member on a Los Angeles road is a grief that arrives all at once and then keeps arriving. In 2025, the city recorded 330 traffic deaths, many of them along corridors like the 101, the 5 and the 110 that so many households drive every day. A wrongful death claim is the civil path California gives those families. It is separate from any criminal case the district attorney may or may not pursue, and it does not depend on a conviction. Under state law, a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to file; certain dependents and heirs may qualify when there is no spouse or child. The clock generally runs two years from the date of death, and it can be much shorter if a Los Angeles County agency or other government body is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect Los Angeles families, free of charge, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Los Angeles Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is far shorter when a city, county or state agency is a party. Getting connected now protects that timeline.

items.title: Every category of loss considered
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash happened on a Los Angeles freeway and the police report is still pending. Can we start now?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and does not wait on the outcome of a police investigation or any criminal charges. Reports on high-volume corridors such as the Golden State Freeway or the Harbor Freeway can take time to finalize, and an attorney can begin gathering evidence in the meantime.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring the claim?
items.answer: California puts the surviving spouse or registered domestic partner and the children first in line. If there is no spouse or child, certain dependents and other heirs may qualify. Because these rules can get complicated, an attorney will typically confirm standing before filing.

items.question: Does it cost anything to connect with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service and is not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network take wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning they are paid only if there is a recovery for your family.
